$comment: The show itself, for 'About the show', and the recurring guests. Phrases and link patterns are case-insensitive regexes matched against post text, link URLs and link titles.

performableThreads.$comment: Threads a writer could stage word for word. All conditions must hold. avoidPatterns are case-insensitive regexes for hostile wording; any match rejects the thread. prefetch: how many candidate threads are fetched in full with getPostThread so they are complete.
